newsitem.title: COMOROS: Murderer sentenced to death in Comoro Islands.
newsitem.headline: Murderer sentenced to death in Comoro Islands.

text.p: A court in the Indian Ocean Comoro Islands sentenced to death a man for murdering a 60-year-old woman who caught him stealing bananas, officials said on Friday.
The death sentence issued by a Moroni court on Thursday was the second to be delivered in Comoros in three days in a crackdown ordered by President Mohamed Taki against murderers.

The officials said 40-year-old Youssouf Hamadi was sentenced on Thursday to death for the pre-meditated murder of 60-year-old Echata Madi last October after she caught him stealing bananas from her grove.

A Moroni court on Tuesday sentenced Said Ali Mohamed from the village of Chezami to death for killing three people from the neighbouring village of Hamtzimdzi in July after a fight broke out at a football match between the two villages.
Only Taki as president can pardon those sentenced to death and he refused in September to pardon a 25-year-old man who murdered a pregnant woman. Ali Youssouf was publicly executed by firing squad.
The previous public execution in Comoros was in 1978.
